question: Use of tamoxifen for breast cancer can cause all ofthe following adverse effects, exceptaEUR'
analysis: Tamoxifen is a selective estrogen receptor modulator (SERM) used in the treatment of estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer. It is known to have several adverse effects. Thromboembolism is a recognized risk due to its estrogenic effects on the liver, which can increase clotting factors. Endometrial carcinoma is a potential risk because tamoxifen acts as an estrogen agonist in the uterus, which can stimulate endometrial proliferation. Cataracts have also been reported as a possible side effect. However, tamoxifen is generally protective against the development of breast cancer in the contralateral breast, rather than causing it.
